author: Kusha N M
raw:
ತಾಯಾಗಿ ಸಲಹುವನು ಪಿತನಂತೆ ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವ
ನಾಯಕತ್ವದ ಗುಣವ ಮನದಿ ಮೂಡಿಸುವ
ಕಾಯಕವನರಹುತಲೆ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ ಬೋಧಿಸುತ
ಹಾಯಿಸುವ ಜಗವ ಗುರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: He nurtures like a mother and protects like a father;
he brings forth the quality of leadership in the mind;
teaching work and instructing in duty,
the guru steers the world, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Written for Guru Pūrṇimā. The teacher nurtures like a mother, protects like a father, awakens leadership, and teaches work and duty. Through such teachers the world moves forward.
